thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Detected spike of 5xx and gateway timeouts in us-west-2 edge/gateway. Error rate > 4% across multiple routes, automatic pager created. Trigger: gateway-5xx-rate > alert-threshold.

oncall-ops: Ack, taking lead. Paging SRE and Infra.

sre-elaine: I'm in. Initial look: spikes correlate with kv-cache TTL expirations on several frontends — sudden cache misses causing backend fanout. Rolling 502/504s and some connection resets.

infra-aaron: Seeing NAT conntrack growth on edge NAT instances in us-west-2; some SYN_RECV churn. Could be connection churn from backend retries. Pushing conntrack stats now:

```
# on nat-proxy-usw2-01
ss -s | head -n 1
Tcp: total 123456 (estab 2345, timewait 90000, orphan 2, synrecv 123)
/proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count = 480000 (limit 524288)
```

eng-runtime: I'm tailing gateway logs, pattern shows upstream timeouts to mlworker pools and 502s from the router when KV TTLs spike. Example:

```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=mlworker-usw2-3 timeout=10s kv_miss=true
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] route=/v1/embeddings status=504 upstream=embedder-usw2-7 connect_timeout
```

prod-support: Customer impact: ~2.8% of requests failing overall, some customers seeing up to 8% errors in the last 15m. Notifying top impacted accounts (lists sent to #customer-comms).

network-ops: NLB target health shows transient unhealthy flapping for some edgeworkers. Still within autoscaling but adding latency.

oncall-ops: Immediate mitigation options?

infra-aaron: Short term: increase conntrack limit, drain unhealthy NAT nodes, and rotate edgepool. Medium term: enable cross-region fallback for critical routes to us-east-1.

eng-runtime: We can enable fallback routing by patching the route-policy. Recommend staged shift: 20% -> 50% traffic to us-east-1 variant that uses smaller model shard (less memory) to reduce upstream timeouts.

oncall-ops: Do we have automated playbooks? observability-bot, link runbook please.

observability-bot: Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/edge-fallback-orch (steps: patch route, monitor 5xx, rollback)

sre-elaine: Executing step 1: bump conntrack on nat-proxies.

infra-aaron: Running:
```
for i in nat-proxy-usw2-*; do ssh $i sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=750000; done
```

eng-runtime: I'll open the fallback route change (staging 20%). Patch command:

```
# shipctl route apply --route gateway:/v1/generate --policy '{"fallback": [{"region":"us-east-1","weight":20}], "circuit_breaker": {"consecutive_5xx": 10}}'
```

oncall-ops: Apply when infra confirms conntrack bump.

infra-aaron: Conntrack bumped, some nodes rotated, drain in progress.

eng-runtime: Patching now.

eng-runtime: Patch applied: 20% traffic routed to us-east-1 variant. Monitoring.

observability-bot: 5m window: 5xx rate (us-west-2) -> dropped from 4.1% to 2.2%. Overall error rate now 1.5%.

prod-support: Customer updates sent for high-impact customers. Alpha customer A saw immediate improvement after shift.

network-ops: NLB flapping reduced. SYN_RECV remainder still slightly above baseline but stable.

sre-elaine: Next step: increase fallback to 50% for more headroom while we stabilize backend. Any objections?

eng-runtime: No objections. We should also lower the circuit breaker sensitivity temporarily to avoid broad retries (set consecutive_5xx -> 12).

oncall-ops: Proceeding to 50% shift.

eng-runtime: Applying:
```
shipctl route apply --route gateway:/v1/generate --policy '{"fallback": [{"region":"us-east-1","weight":50}], "circuit_breaker": {"consecutive_5xx": 12}}'
```

eng-runtime: Done. 50% to us-east-1.

observability-bot: 10m after: overall 5xx down to 0.9%. Latency on us-east-1 higher by ~40ms but within SLA.

prod-support: Escalated communications: PSR and status page updated to note partial regional degradation and fallback routing.

network-ops: Suggests increasing autoscaler scale-out threshold for mlworker-usw2 pools to catch up with missed cache heat. Scheduling immediate scale-up: replicas +30%.

infra-aaron: K8s scale command in progress:
```
kubectl scale deployment/mlworker-usw2 --replicas=65 -n production
```

eng-runtime: We'll also enable short-term kv-prefill for hot prefixes to reduce future cold miss storms (script will repopulate top 200 keys). Running now.

prod-support: Monitoring impacted customer success flows; CS on standby for direct outreach.

oncall-ops: Handoff: I'm handing incident to secondary oncall @sre-elaine for ongoing stabilization and post-incident writeup. ETA for full recovery in 30-60m.

sre-elaine: Taking over. Current state: traffic split 50/50 us-west-2/us-east-1, 5xx within normal, autoscale started, conntrack normalized. Continuing to monitor for recurrence.

network-ops: Note: we'll follow up with deep dive into NAT connection churn root cause (likely retry storm + cache TTL jitter).

observability-bot: Final check at 15:05Z: us-west-2 5xx=0.4%, overall 0.3%. Marking incident as mitigated. Will create incident ticket and assign postmortem to SRE and Eng Runtime.

prod-support: Preparing customer summary for incident report.

sre-elaine: Closing the on-call handoff. Postmortem owners: sre-elaine, eng-runtime, infra-aaron.

oncall-ops: Great work team. Will follow up in #postmortems with timeline + logs. :thumbsup:
